extracted.name: Chicken Cornflakes
extracted.description: Perfect fried chicken with the crispiest and most flavorful crunchy outside and moist and juicy meat on the inside 😋 If you like my recipes, please follow my Instagram @jenscookingdiary for the Indonesian recipes or @jenscookdineandtravel for the English recipes 🙏🏻😊😘
ingredient_lines: 500 gr boneless chicken thigh, diced 3x3 cm
500 ml vegetable oil for deep frying the chicken
instruction_lines: In a food processor, grind cornflakes, for a while, into smaller pieces (please don’t over grind).
In a bowl, add cornflakes with the other coating ingredients. Mix well. Set aside. in a different bowl, mix all batter ingredients well.
Dip the chicken into batter ingredients.
Press the chicken slowly and evenly in coating ingredients.
Deep fry the chicken over medium high heat until crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the pan. Place the chicken on the paper towel to absorb the excessive oil.
Serve chicken with chili sauce or tomato ketchup or mayonnaise. Yum! 😋
